notes.title: Thank you to every single one of our backers!
notes.content:
Our KickStarter campaign draws to a close today, and we are extremely grateful for all the support we have received. It is not easy to create and complete a game, especially a VR game being produced during the last 12 months! But we have come very close to finishing a project that was only a dream one year ago. 

The nightmare global pandemic changed everything and we ran out of funds. Pure and simple. Equally, it has been very difficult to raise awareness of a game without build, without a trailer, without a playable format and without substantial teaser videos to get the industry excited. We have not enjoyed much support from the media because of this as we have been deemed as 'too early stage' but amazingly, you, the public has been more curious, despite only having small pieces of information on the darkest of forests in FINSTERWALD and of course, our main protagonist, the WALDSCHRAT. 

Therefore, due to so much demand from a core base of early fans and our resolute and determined team, we have decided to continue and finish the project. We will find the funds somehow and you will all, finally, be able to enter FINSTERWALD and come face to face with the WALDSCHRAT. Will it be a friend or foe? You will find out on STEAM or a host of other platforms which we have engaged in preliminary discussions with. 

Stay with us on our channels for more updates: 
[url=https://discord.gg/SQYF49G3]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/PolyReality]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.reddit.com/user/PolyReality]Reddit[/url]


Thank you, friends!
